english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for a thought, notion, or way of thinking.
This is the all-purpose colloquial noun for an idea or a person's way of thinking.
Use this as the all-purpose everyday noun for an idea or personal view.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a person's idea, notion, or mental conception.
Use this all-purpose everyday word when the sentiment means a general thought, view, or opinion rather than an emotion.
This is the all-purpose everyday choice for a person's way of thinking, views, and plans; for intention it means the person's intended course or plan.
Use this for someone’s idea or casually formed notion, especially when presenting it as their way of thinking.
